headline: Sensex and Nifty decline from day highs as crude oil prices surge and banking stocks drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices put downward pressure on benchmark indices.
Banking stocks dragged the market down, erasing early morning gains.
Sensex slumped over 900 points from its day high during the trading session.
RBI MPC flagged widening inflationary pressures.
whatHappening: Sensex declined 143.21 points to settle at 73,709.69 while Nifty dropped to 22,811.35.
Mahindra Finance reported a 55% jump in Q2 net profit to ₹882 crore on strong loan growth.
Navratri retail vehicle sales reached 11.23 lakh units led by two-wheelers and passenger vehicles.
IT stocks showed resilience and outperformed the broader weak market sentiment.
summary: Indian benchmark indices fell on October 21 after an early morning rally fizzled out. Sensex dropped 143 points to settle at 73,709.69, while Nifty ended near 22,811 amid spiking crude oil prices and banking sell-off. Mahindra Finance surged after posting a 55% increase in Q2 net profit.
